_doc: Factions. native_terrain grants native_bonus to every creature of the faction fighting there (see combat_config.native_terrain_bonus). hostile_terrain applies the hostile penalty. economy: curve (early|steady|late: when the faction's army peaks) and key_resources (rare resources its creature costs and buildings lean on; creature costs may only use gold, wood, ore and these). roster: one-line identity, see docs/FACTIONS.md. starting_heroes (optional): a faction trait, the heroes its players start a standard game with instead of game_rules starting_heroes.

darkelf.name: The Umbral Court
darkelf.roster: Swift assassins, crossbows, cave riders and dragons, backed by veil magic.

fishmen.name: The Abyssal Shoal
fishmen.roster: Armoured reef warriors, harpoons, sea beasts and tide magic.

concord.name: The Aldmere Concord
concord.roster: Disciplined combined arms: pikes, shields, bows, heavy horse, healers.

ashen.name: The Ashen Host
ashen.roster: Fast, fragile, aggressive melee swarms; few ranged units.

hollow.name: The Hollow Dominion
hollow.roster: Slow, mindless attrition: no morale, raise the fallen, drain life.

thornwood.name: The Thornwood Covenant
thornwood.roster: Mostly ranged, guarded by living trees; no cavalry.

forge.name: The Sunken Forge
forge.roster: Slow, armoured and expensive; constructs and siege guns; no flyers.

frostmarch.name: The Frostmarch Clans
frostmarch.roster: Cheap, numerous raiders and beast cavalry; no archers, no flyers.
